where: Playful houses — Georgina's cottage (the Sunniest House in the Dark) and the Lifting House on Pearlmoor Quay
mood: Sunny rooms with a wink — a sprightly, cheeky little ocarina tune that skips about the furniture.
_note: Matches the classic spec: 126 BPM 4/4, C major, A / A' / B (F major, D7-G7 turn) / A'' form. No motif (tempo is the point).
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
C major with cheeky chromatic grace notes
ocarina-like whistle lead with skipping staccato phrases
staccato bassoon-like bass hopping on root and fifth
playful, quirky, comic and warm, a cosy small room

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a cheeky xylophone run tumbles down, a tambourine shake, and the staccato bass hops straight into the bounce}
styles: full presence from the first beat

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the sprightly ocarina melody in C major, skipping staccato notes with a winking chromatic step, over the hopping bassoon bass and offbeat pizzicato}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the tune again, xylophone answering each phrase with a little run, the tambourine brighter}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a sunny lift to F major, the ocarina sings longer notes, then a sly turnaround through D7 and G7 like a wink}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the skipping theme returns in C major, warm and cheeky; the last bar walks up a semitone straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
